title: Security packaging experiment: tiered SSO/SAML & RBAC contractual commitments
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Design and run a packaging + pricing experiment that codifies SSO/SAML and RBAC commitments as purchasable contract tiers. Goal: reduce friction in sales conversations for security-sensitive customers while preserving pricing flexibility and limiting liability. Deliver an experiment definition, sample contract language, price bands, and rollout plan for trial customers.
acceptance_criteria: Experiment design approved by Legal and Security (signed off in Confluence doc)
Three tier definitions (Essentials, Secure, Secure+) with explicit SSO/SAML and RBAC commitments drafted
Customer-facing pricing table and add-on SKU for RBAC integration published in sales playbook
Pilot agreements signed with 2 sales opportunities using the new commitments
Telemetry in Console updated to show RBAC mapping usage and SSO provision success for pilot customers
decisions: Introduce 'Secure' and 'Secure+' tiers rather than making SSO/RBAC baseline for all enterprise plans to preserve self-serve simplicity

Contractual commitments will be scoped to 'availability of documented SSO/SAML integration steps', 'role mapping support level', and 'response SLAs for security escalations' instead of absolute uptime guarantees for auth systems
Charge RBAC mapping as a one-time professional services SKU for custom schema mapping; provide basic mapping templates included in Secure+
Limit legal indemnity exposure by adding explicit boundary clauses for customer-managed IdP issues and agreed-on migration windows

rollout_plan: Phase 0 (Pilot): Offer Secure/Secure+ to 2-3 inbound enterprise opportunities via Sales for 90-day pilot
Phase 1 (Beta): Publish Secure add-on SKU in sales catalog and trial with SDR-assisted motions
Phase 2 (General Availability): Launch to all new enterprise contracts with standardized appendix and approved SOW template
Rollback criteria: if legal objections delay >30 days or pilot NPS < 6, pause rollout and re-evaluate commitments
metrics: Pilot conversion rate on deals offered Secure add-on >= 25%
Average negotiation time reduction for security appendix <= 10 business days
Number of contract redlines per SOW reduced by 50% compared to historical baseline
Customer-reported integration time for SAML + basic RBAC mapping <= 2 weeks for Secure tier
Pilot telemetry: successful SAML assertions per hour and role mapping error rate < 0.5%
